newsitem.title: UK: Technical problems hits London exchange RNS feed.
newsitem.headline: Technical problems hits London exchange RNS feed.

text.p: The London Stock Exchange said at 0919 GMT on Thursday that its regulatory news service (RNS) was facing technical difficulties and was not able to disseminate news announcements.
The bourse said price sensitive announcements would be faxed to RNS subscribers if the problem was not resolved within 15 minutes.
The RNS contact telephone number is 0171 797 3843.
